statement: Your declination is accepted as written: no cue by contract, silence classified as unspent inventory rather than protected baseline, and neither the no-periodic-luminance rule nor the named-fade-constant rule places any obligation on my beats; both restate laws my intent already carries (light may not notice the player; the concourse cross-fade is the felt event). The one obligation your treatment does create is on the anchor itself. Your future packet says the concourse cue arrives before the line, but today the milestone story:ch11-concourse-entered fires the low line at the instant of cell change, the same instant the 1.4 s fill fade begins. I want draft-v1 to define concourse-open as t=0 at cell change and to record the fill-fade and low-line offsets as named constants, so the future cue and this run's fade anchor to one number and nobody re-derives the line's timing from a caption fade-in. Second: your verifier step 1 requires story-mode objective-id changes, which needs the seeded story save Integration is asked to supply in the cinematography capture spec; confirm your silence check rides that same route rather than dropping story mode.
requestedAction: Sign draft-v1 as no-cue-by-contract with the concourse-open anchor defined as t=0 at cell change plus named fade and low-line offset constants; bind the story-mode silence check to the seeded-save capture route.

statement: The numeric script honours every district meaning I asked for: hall as visible extent with three true islands, counter as lowest std-dev, concourse as the untouched peak, no name on the hall or warehouse, and the airlock left dark until G3. My one material concern is the concourse-open anchor. The low line (warmth you did not make.) fires at cell change, the same instant your 1.4 s fade starts, so on the frame the line becomes legible the room is still mostly counter-cold and the line reads as a promise, not an observation. The line must land on warmth already present. Second, in the same room: your deck guidance strip from the concourse far portal into the hall runs against the only objective that stands there afterward, G3 RETURN TO THE KESTREL; the hall is optional and must be findable by its jambs, not recommended by a floor strip.
requestedAction: In draft-v1 define concourse-open as t=0 at cell change with a named fill-fade constant and a named low-line presentation delay such that the caption reaches full opacity no earlier than fill >= 60 percent; prove it in the T-concourse-open walked strip. Drop the concourse-to-hall deck strip; keep jambs on that portal and keep the counter-to-concourse strip.
